object.name: session_backlight_manager
object.description: Interface for creating objects for backlight and LED devices. A client may only create or modify an object while it owns an active local session.

s2c.name: failed
s2c.description: Sent when get_device receives an unsupported subsystem or an invalid device name, or when the requested device cannot be opened.

c2s.name: get_device
c2s.description: Creates a `session_backlight_device` object for the device identified by subsystem and name. The subsystem must be `backlight` or `leds`.

object.name: session_backlight_device
object.description: Interface for changing the brightness of one device selected by the subsystem and name passed to `get_device`. A client may only perform an operation while it owns an active local session. The result of each operation is reported with done or set_brightness_failed.

s2c.name: set_brightness_failed
s2c.description: Sent when the caller does not have permission to change brightness or writing the requested brightness fails.

c2s.name: set_brightness
c2s.description: Sets brightness for this device in /sys/class/backlight or /sys/class/leds.
